# Project Design Context

Updated from project sources and the approved local design direction on 2026-09-27.

## Project

- Name: naengtalk-workspace
- Product type: Mobile-first food inventory and recipe assistant
- Stack: Expo, React Native, TypeScript
- Color mode: light
- Density: comfortable

## Sources

- Tokens: `mobile/src/features/theme.ts`
- Components: `mobile/src/features/NaengTalk.tsx`
- Assets: `mobile/assets/icon.png`
- Instructions: AGENTS.md

## Components

- Installed: Existing React Native primitives and Lucide icons
- Preferred primitives: `View`, `Pressable`, `Text`

## Tokens

- Primary green: `#2f7740`
- App background: `#f5f7f2`
- Door surfaces: fresh `#eef5e9`, warm `#fff5df`, satin sky blue `#eaf3f7`
- Card radius: 20px; web phone frame radius: 38px
- Refrigerator-door depth: uniform 3px white inner rim with a stronger lower-right exterior shadow

## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve the 2:1 home content ratio and responsive 4-6 inventory rows.
- Maintain readable Korean labels and strong contrast.
- Keep content and navigation inside the 9:20 frame.
- Treat the three home cards as one refrigerator through a shared satin surface language.

### Avoid

- Blur or translucent glass, continuous decorative animation, and new dependencies.
- Changing approved information architecture during visual polish.

## Decisions

- 2026-09-27: selected the **Satin Refrigerator Door** direction. The three home cards keep their existing layout while gaining top/left sheen, lower/right depth, and tactile pressed feedback. Implemented locally and awaiting user approval before deployment.
- 2026-09-27: replaced the ambiguous lower-right door mark with a recessed handle asset. The upper door handle sits at its bottom edge and both lower drawer handles sit at their top edges. The complete 360×800 canvas scales uniformly on small devices instead of reflowing.
- 2026-09-27: vertically inverted the two lower-door handles so their recessed grip opens downward. Cooking tools now use two near-square columns without decorative pot icons; a separated red delete control anchors each card bottom.
- 2026-09-27: replaced partial sheen lines with a complete white inner rim, changed the menu card to light satin sky blue, compacted common section headers to about 70%, standardized the first-content gap at 16px, and centered tool names above the destructive action.
- 2026-09-27: increased shared primary CTA labels from 14px to 16px with a 20px line height and semibold weight; compact utility, destructive, sorting, and navigation labels keep their existing hierarchy.
- 2026-09-27: increased both home action-card titles by 2px to responsive 16/17/19px steps while keeping one-line fitting. After the same-copy comparison, selected bundled SUIT Regular/Medium/SemiBold/Bold for Korean and English text throughout the app.
- 2026-09-27: separated allergy registration and allergy management into two cards. Allergy rows use a green bullet and a compact red delete control consistent with cooking-tool deletion.
- 2026-09-27: after user approval, deployed the complete refrigerator-surface, responsive-canvas, compact-header, larger-CTA, SUIT typography, cooking-tool, and allergy-list design set to EAS Hosting production.
- 2026-09-27: changed the common header to a stronger 21px single-line title; only Home keeps its tagline, inline beside `냉톡`. Added a compact `Today / MM.DD` block aligned with the urgent inventory date column and red date emphasis for items earlier than the device-local day.
- 2026-09-27: deployed the approved header and expiry-visibility update to EAS Hosting production after a clean web export; verified the fixed production URL shows the new local-date block and no longer shows the sample-date caption.
